apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Log in to your Sendr dashboard at https://app.sendr.io, go to **Settings > API Keys**, click **Create New Key** and paste the key here.

get_user_info.afterResponse: const flat = (o, p) => { const r = {}; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o || {})) { const key = p ? p + '_' + k : k; if (v == null) r[key] = null; else if (Array.isArray(v)) r[key] = v.map(x => typeof x === 'object' ?
